title: In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2610.00921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.   Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources

translated_title: 在交叉熵方法（CEM）中，世界模型同时也是一种提案机制
translated_abstract: 交叉熵方法（CEM）使用世界模型的评分来选择动作序列，并拟合下一次迭代中采样的分布。因此，评分误差既会改变当前的决策，也会改变后续考虑的候选动作。我们分别评估了这两个角色。四种类型的预测模型生成CEM轨迹，且每个模型都会对每个保存的候选池重新评分。在环境中执行相同的候选动作可提供参考的精英集和提案更新。在Walker和Cheetah上的十二个独立训练的任务-种子单元中，预先指定的提案距离在每个单元中从第一次CEM迭代到最后一次迭代均呈下降趋势。提案宽度收缩，拟合均值相对于剩余搜索宽度出现分离。成对排序一致性在Walker上接近随机水平，在Cheetah上有所下降；精英集的一致性没有改善。这一比较显示，评分器之间的差异大于候选池来源之间的差异。
tldr: 本文分离评估了CEM中世界模型的两种角色，发现世界模型不仅是决定当前动作的评分器，还是塑造后续候选分布的提案机制，且不同评分模型之间的差异大于候选池来源之间的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles the two roles of the world model in CEM, showing it acts both as a scorer for current decisions and as a proposal mechanism shaping future candidate distributions, with variation between scoring models exceeding that between candidate pool sources.
